items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: And so I got McShann to let me -- let me hire Bird and he pay me -- you know, I'd act as Bird's agent.

ctx.x: And so they got Jimmy Cole in the band. Well, after about two weeks we started getting so many complaints and things, and Bird would come by, and different ones of us would give him some money to eat and so forth. He was still working at the Monroe's Uptown House, you know, after hour joint, but he didn't make no money.

And so I got McShann to let me -- let me hire Bird and he pay me -- you know, I'd act as Bird's agent. And I'd take care of him, you know. So we got Bird back in the band. And I think Cole stayed with us then. He did and started playing baritone.

Now, we stayed -- they stayed in the band until we got back -- now, they sent us on a tour. I'm getting ahead of myself. We went on a tour to -- down South. And we played Augusta, ballroom in Augusta, and halftime the man left with the money. The cops came and made us -- we were either going to pay for that dance and pay for the cops -- pay for the rent of the hall and pay for the bouncers and the people on the door, or else we had to go to jail.
